title: CmdPal: Add a Performance Monitor Overview card and dock band

proposed_comments.title: Resolve saved Overview pins through the provider
proposed_comments.body:
**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/ext/Microsoft.CmdPal.Ext.PerformanceMonitor/PerformanceMonitorCommandsProvider.cs`, `PerformanceWidgetsPage.cs`, and `SystemOverviewWidgetPage.cs`.

**Problem:** The Overview list entry is a `ListItem` whose page ID is `com.microsoft.cmdpal.overview_widget`. The provider inherits `CommandProvider` but has no `GetCommandItem` override; the base method returns `null`. CmdPal offers pin commands for this item, then restores saved home pins via `GetCommandItem` and keeps only non-null results, so the saved Overview item is omitted. Dock restoration first searches top-level commands and then calls `GetCommandItem`; the registered Overview dock band has a different ID (`com.microsoft.cmdpal.performanceWidget.overview`), and the list item does not specify a `DockCommandId` mapping.

**Why it matters:** A user can select Pin for the Overview, but its saved item cannot be reconstructed on the home page or as a pinned dock item after reload. Registering the separate band does not resolve the content-page ID.

**Suggested change:** Resolve the existing Overview item by its saved ID.

1. Override `GetCommandItem` in `PerformanceMonitorCommandsProvider` and return the existing Overview list item for `com.microsoft.cmdpal.overview_widget`. Reuse the item rather than creating a second set of metric pages.
2. Return `null` for IDs the provider does not recognize.
3. Add a provider lookup test for both IDs and verify that home and dock pins restore after reload.

**Verification:** Confirmed the null-returning inherited lookup and both restore paths against upstream head `2838b5be77cf6b57803123fae6261dc293a371a`; the Overview entry, band, and page IDs differ as described. No build or interactive pin test was run.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The missing GetCommandItem resolver is outside the changed ranges; the finding is grounded by the new Overview ID and unchanged provider/host lookup paths.

confidence.rationale: Exact upstream inherited null-returning method and explicit saved-pin consumers establish failed resolution. UI execution is not claimed.
